items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: And I played with him I mean I was Alfred introduced me to Sidney Desmond after he had told Sidney Desmond to come and listen to me play.

ctx.x: And how'd you get the job and what happened? Where'd you play?

Well, I was recommended by the same guy Alfred Williams which was very instrumental in my welfare and so he recommended me to Sidney Desmond he says I have a How do you spell Sidney's name? S-I-D-N-E-Y D-I-S-V-I-G-N-E Uh-huh. And I played with him I mean I was Alfred introduced me to Sidney Desmond after he had told Sidney Desmond to come and listen to me play.
